module.name: sample_capture
module.description:
Sample capture across a clock boundary.

Registers samples from a free-running converter clock (adc_clk) and hands
them to the system clock (clk) through an asynchronous FIFO. The enable
and clear requests go the other way through two-flop synchronisers, so
neither domain samples a signal that changes under its own clock edge.

mermaid.caption: Capture data path
mermaid.source:
flowchart LR
  subgraph sys[clk domain]
    E[enable] --> C[p_ctrl]
    O[p_out] --> S[sample_data]
  end
  subgraph adc[adc_clk domain]
    N[p_adc_en] --> R[p_adc_capture]
    D[adc_data] --> R
  end
  C -- capture_en, clear_req --> N
  R -- samples --> F[(async_fifo)]
  F --> O

generics.name: STICKY_OVERFLOW
generics.description: Keep overflow set until reset (1), or show it for one cycle per lost sample (0).

ports.name: rst_n
ports.description: System-domain asynchronous active-low reset, released synchronously (from a reset_sync on clk).

ports.name: clear_overflow
ports.description: Clears the overflow flag while high (system clock domain).

ports.name: adc_rst
ports.description: Converter-domain synchronous active-high reset, released on adc_clk.

ports.name: sample_data
ports.description: Oldest unread sample, valid while sample_valid is high.

ports.name: sample_valid
ports.description: A sample is waiting on sample_data.

ports.name: sample_ready
ports.description: Consumer takes the sample this cycle.

ports.name: overflow
ports.description: Set when a sample arrived while the FIFO was full (held until clear_overflow when STICKY_OVERFLOW). Changes under adc_clk, so the reader must treat it as asynchronous.

processes.label: p_ctrl
processes.description: p_ctrl: Registers the enable and clear requests on the system clock.

processes.label: p_out
processes.description: p_out: Presents the oldest sample to the consumer.

processes.label: p_adc_en
processes.description: p_adc_en: Brings capture_en and clear_req into the converter domain.

processes.label: p_adc_capture
processes.description: p_adc_capture: Registers each sample and flags FIFO overflow.
